facts.raw_span: one-day history of fever, cough, and sore throat
Temperature: 39.2°C
Pulse: 129 beats per minute
Respiratory rate: 22 breaths per minute
Cervix dilated to 3 cm
Respiratory rate increased to 28-30 breaths per minute
Oxygen saturation: 86% on room air, 96% on 10L oxygen
Fine crepitations on lung examination
Pink frothy sputum noted on endotracheal aspiration
White blood cell count: 13.4 × 10⁹/L
Patchy infiltrates in the upper and middle lobes of the right lung
Real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue: Positive for influenza A (H3N2) virus

support_spans: Oxygen saturation: 86% on room air, 96% on 10L oxygen
Pink frothy sputum noted on endotracheal aspiration
concepts.why: The patient's low oxygen saturation and the presence of pink frothy sputum are indicative of acute respiratory distress syndrome, a condition characterized by inflammation and injury to the lungs.

support_spans: Real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue: Positive for influenza A (H3N2) virus
concepts.why: The patient's positive PCR result for influenza A (H3N2) virus confirms the diagnosis of influenza, which is a common cause of respiratory illness during pregnancy.

support_spans: Respiratory rate increased to 28-30 breaths per minute
Oxygen saturation: 86% on room air, 96% on 10L oxygen
Fine crepitations on lung examination
Pink frothy sputum noted on endotracheal aspiration
concepts.why: The combination of increased respiratory rate, low oxygen saturation, and fine crepitations on lung examination, along with pink frothy sputum, suggests a process of diffuse lung injury and inflammation, consistent with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.

support_spans: Real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue: Positive for influenza A (H3N2) virus
Patchy infiltrates in the upper and middle lobes of the right lung
concepts.why: The positive real-time PCR for influenza A (H3N2) virus, along with the presence of patchy infiltrates on chest radiograph, suggests a process of viral pneumonia, consistent with Influenza Pneumonia.

support_spans: Cervix dilated to 3 cm
Blood pressure elevated to 200/120 mm Hg
concepts.why: The combination of elevated blood pressure and cervical dilation in a pregnant woman suggests a process of pregnancy-induced hypertension, consistent with Preeclampsia.

support_spans: Initial stress test showed normal fetal heartbeats
Later monitoring showed fetal tachycardia
Final monitoring showed decreased fetal heart sounds (80-90 beats per minute)
concepts.why: The combination of abnormal fetal heart rate patterns, including tachycardia and decreased fetal heart sounds, suggests a process of fetal compromise, consistent with Acute Fetal Distress.
